message: 疾風のごとく（笑）
Patrolling as usual.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Goodness, what Mr. Bonus says really isn't reliable at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Peace is number one, phone calls are number two!!」

name: Ria
message: 「'I wonder if it's time for our three o'clock snack yet♪'」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, it's actually kind of eerie how quiet things are.」

name: Ria
message: 「They might be plotting something, after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President. Is something the matter?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Are you hungry?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's you, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. You caught me\s04」

name: Ardin
message: 「So it's you guys. The ones who've been sniffing around about demons lately.」
「So it's you guys. The ones who've been sniffing around about demons lately.」

name: Ardin
message: 「And word is you've been driving demons back to the Demon World, too. Mere humans pulling a stupid stunt like that.」
「And word is you've been driving demons back to the Demon World, too. Mere humans pulling a stupid stunt like that.」

name: Ardin
message: 「But more importantly than that!! You've been hurting the one I love. That's what really pissed me off!!」
「But more importantly than that!! You've been hurting the one I love. That's what really pissed me off!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please don't say strange things all of a sudden.」

name: Misa
message: 「By 'the one I love,' I wonder if he means Sally or Eauderourke?」

name: Ardin
message: 「Eauderourke!? A freak like that...... Uuurgh, now I'm definitely never forgiving you......!」
「Eauderourke!? A freak like that...... Uuurgh, now I'm definitely never forgiving you......!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eauderourke sure is famous.」

name: Ardin
message: 「He's one of the Seven Demon Generals too, right? Well, he's minor league compared to the great me, though」
「He's one of the Seven Demon Generals too, right? Well, he's minor league compared to the great me, though」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh, wait, could that mean……」

name: Ardin
message: 「I am one of the Seven Demon Generals, known to the masses as Ardin of the Gale」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gale? What part of you?」

name: Ardin
message: 「I just felt like calling myself that today」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This guy. Confirmed idiot」

name: Ardin
message: 「Hey, woman. You've got some nerve, don't ya」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And what exactly do you think you can do all by yourself?」
From the looks of it, he doesn't appear to have any underlings in tow like Oderouk or Sally-chan did.

name: Ardin
message: 「I'm a lone wolf. I follow no one, and I command no one」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So you just have zero charisma, then~. How pitiful」

name: Ardin
message: 「Grouping up is for weaklings. I don't have any need for that」

name: Synn
message: 「You're pretty confident in yourself, aren't you?」

name: Ardin
message: 「It's been a while since I went on a rampage in the Human World. I'm gonna enjoy this to the fullest」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is your little revenge drama over already?」

name: Ardin
message: 「Stop nitpicking every single thing I say!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-This is……!」

name: Synn
message: 「What intense pressure\s01」

name: Ardin
message: 「I'll beat the true measure of those called the Seven Demon Generals right into those weakling bodies of yours!」
